headline: Top Nigerian Investors Suffer N2.19 Trillion Equity Loss in Market Downturn
summary: The total market value of listed holdings belonging to Aliko Dangote, Femi Otedola, and four other major investors dropped by N2.19 trillion between November 16 and 20.
why: The Nigerian Exchange (NGX) features concentrated shareholding among key industrial conglomerates and local holdings.

impacts.name: NGX All-Share Index
impacts.why: Major equity holdings lost N2.19 trillion in market valuation over a five-day span.
